$comment: Machine-readable delivery status for every requirement ID in
docs/functional-requirements.md, in spec order. Read by tools/fleet to decide
what to queue next. It is a work list, not a source of truth: docs/spec.md and
the README are, and where this file disagrees with one, this file is wrong.
A bare "partial" is rejected: the remaining line is the only part a later pass
cannot work out by reading the repo.
One line per ID, and every ID is always present, so landing a requirement is a
single-line edit rather than an insert - two branches changing different IDs do

XCUT-001.remaining: The keystore file driver and local blob adapter now reject relative config.path (a real gap: it was baked into the manifest at init and silently re-resolved against whatever directory a later command ran from), and TestUpSucceedsFromBundleCopiedToAnotherDirectory proves `up` itself succeeds from a bundle physically relocated after the directory it was saved to no longer exists. That covers every operation landed so far that consumes a loaded bundle (init, up, status; import addresses instances directly and never touches a bundle). Extend the same relocated-bundle proof to backup, restore, promote, upgrade, and drill as each lands its own CLI/core path (BKUP-*, RSTR-*, FAIL-*, UPGR-*, DRIL-*, still open) — none of those exist yet to test.
